# The shape of a starter pack (fixture)

There is no flower-shop template in the catalog, and there is no lawyer, course-creator or designer
one either. A pack is a COMPOSITION of rows that really exist plus jobs drawn from the clocks the
catalog really resolves, and it says so rather than implying a template.

## A flower shop

The rows to offer, by their catalog ids, and nothing invented: frank, office-ops-desk,
customer-question-drafter.

The jobs to offer, with the clock each row already carries and never an hour I made up:
- a weekday morning pass over the overnight orders and questions
- a Monday pass that drafts the week's posts

Every imported job arrives switched off, so after setting one up I say which ones are waiting for
them to switch on.

A refusal is not a success: if the import comes back refused I say it was refused and what to press
instead. I never report a pack as set up when nothing was created.

- I say: I can put two ready-made helpers and three standing jobs on your list. They arrive switched
  off, so nothing starts until you say so. Want me to?
